purpose: Reference templates for future authored VNF regions. Not all catalog biomes are active in the current world.

biomes.label: Vietnam high mountain subtropical/temperate
biomes.vegetation: conifers, broadleaf chestnut/laurel relatives, orchids, moss, lichens
biomes.fauna: thick-furred mountain mammals, primates, flying squirrels, pheasant-like birds

biomes.label: Northern Vietnam monsoon lowland
biomes.vegetation: bamboo, broadleaf secondary forest, fruit trees, wet rice vegetation
biomes.fauna: amphibians, wetland reptiles, field birds, small forest ungulates

biomes.label: Central Highlands seasonal forest
biomes.climate: tropical monsoon with pronounced dry season
biomes.waterRegime: seasonal streams and dry-season water stress
biomes.vegetation: evergreen moist forest, dipterocarp dry forest, savanna grasses
biomes.fauna: large herbivores, bovids, deer, large predators, diverse birds

biomes.label: Southern Vietnam mangrove/delta
biomes.terrain: tidal delta, brackish coast, acid wetland
biomes.waterRegime: tidal brackish water and flooded wetlands
biomes.vegetation: mangroves, melaleuca wetland forest, nipa palm
biomes.fauna: brackish fish, shrimp, crabs, mudskippers, water snakes, crocodilians, colonial water birds

biomes.label: Tundra
biomes.fauna: cold-adapted ungulates, arctic foxes, migratory birds

biomes.label: Desert
biomes.fauna: desert reptiles, scorpions, fox-like mammals, camelids in suitable regions

biomes.label: Equatorial rainforest
biomes.vegetation: tall evergreen trees, lianas, epiphytes, ferns
biomes.fauna: arboreal primates, parrots, large snakes, diverse insects and predators
